title: Bake with the lid off
vo: Take the lid off, and turn the oven down to 230 degrees Celsius, or 210 with a fan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes more, until the crust is a deep brown.
voUS: Take the lid off, and turn the oven down to 445 degrees Fahrenheit, or 410 with convection. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes more, until the crust is a deep brown.
cap: Take the lid off. Turn the oven down to 230 °C (210 °C fan).
Bake 25 to 30 minutes more, until deep brown.
capUS: Take the lid off. Turn the oven down to 445 °F (410 °F convection).
Bake 25 to 30 minutes more, until deep brown.
